hypothesis: A material part of the five local station-MAP effects is an observation-support correction between an internal gauge location and an aggregated Reach outlet, not a transferable Reach-flow parameter.
audit_population: all 105 locked development stations; no outcome-based station removal
primary_tests: correlation of station-MAP intercept with negative median log Q72/observation ratio
performance sensitivity on outlet-compatible stations without changing the authoritative 105-station metrics
forbidden: calling a gauge record bad solely because it differs from the Reach outlet
